subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

At a low ebb

options.text: 1. In a depressed or weak state

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"At a low ebb"** means:

 
 
• In a depressed or weak state (कमज़ोर या उदास स्थिति में)
 
 
 
• **Example:** After the company announced the layoffs, the employees' morale was at a low ebb.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1 (In a depressed or weak state).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In a happy state **(खुश स्थिति में):

 
 
• **Example:** She was in a happy state after receiving the good news.
 
 
 
• **In a critical moment **(महत्वपूर्ण क्षण में):
 
 
• **Example:** The team remained calm during the critical moment of the game.
 
 
 
• **In an unemployed mode **(बेरोज़गारी की स्थिति में):
 
 
• **Example:** He has been in an unemployed mode since the company downsized.
 
 

153:Tb10,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
